ModMetaData.name: [scarf] Goblins Don't Deserve Geneva Conventions

ModMetaData.description:
want to play with cannibal: horrible but don't want to care bout goblins? worry no more! adds precept 'goblin exceptionalism' that lets your pawn butcher goblins alive and feel nothing, or even better, good about it (if you're using war crime expanded 2).
currently compatible with: - War Crimes Expanded 2 Core (Updated) - PrisonerManagementPanel(囚犯管理面板)
it's obviously vibe coded so use at your own risk (works on my machine™) source code: https://github.com/scarf005/rimworld-GDGC
